assertions.subject: Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Osteomyelitis presents a lytic picture on imaging

assertions.subject: Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Adjacent intervertebral disc involvement occurs frequently with pyogenic osteomyelitis

assertions.subject: Neoplastic disease
assertions.quote: Osteomyelitis presents a lytic picture on imaging and must be distinguished from neoplastic disease

assertions.subject: Tuberculous Vertebral Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: The infection is indolent and symptoms often progress slowly over months

assertions.subject: Tuberculous Vertebral Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: The involved bodies may have sclerotic rather than lytic changes

assertions.subject: Tuberculous Vertebral Osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Multiple nonadjacent vertebrae may be involved

assertions.subject: Discitis
assertions.quote: The primary symptom is back pain

assertions.subject: Discitis
assertions.quote: Most patients will have spontaneous fusion across the involved disc

assertions.subject: Epidural Abscess
assertions.quote: The most common presenting signs and symptoms are back pain

assertions.subject: Epidural Abscess
assertions.quote: The most significant risk of epidural abscess is weakness progressing to paralysis
